title: Intent frontmatter
description: The frontmatter of .sdlc/cycles/<id>/intent.md. The body carries the problem; this carries only what a machine routes on.

type.description: solution starts a new codebase; suggestion originates from a verify document.

stack.description: Present only when this intent departs from the solution's declared stack.

source.description: For type suggestion: the verify document this came from.

approved_by.description: The person who approved this artifact. Written by them, not by a skill: it is the gate.

approved_at.description: When it was approved. Required alongside approved_by - a name with no date says nothing about which version was approved.

allOf.description: Approval is both fields or neither.
